title: Major disaster declared: Severe Winter Storm, Indiana (DR-1217)
summary: FEMA major disaster declaration for Indiana (severe storm), declared 1998-05-08.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: MERCEDES-BENZ/PART 567 (42 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES.   THE CERTIFICATION LABEL ON THESE VEHICLES FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE LABELING REQUIREMENTS OF PART 567, "CERTIFICATION."

title: Subaru of America, Inc.: SUBARU/FRONT TRANSVERSE LINK (29,442 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER STATION WAGON, SEDAN AND SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES.  DUE TO IMPROPER WELDING, FRACTURES CAN OCCUR ON THE SUPPORT BRACKET OF THE FRONT TRANSVERSE LINK.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: VOLVO TRUCK/DAYTIME RUNNING LIGHTS (2,329 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  CLASS 8 HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS.  THE ELECTRONIC MODULE THAT CONTROLS THE DAYTIME RUNNING LIGHTS (DRL) AND HEADLIGHTS CAN FAIL WITHOUT WARNING RESULTING IN THE LOSS OF THE DRL AND HEADLIGHT FUNCTIONS.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: NISSAN/WINDSHIELD WIPER (512,387 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.  WATER CAN ENTER AND DISPLACE THE GREASE IN THE WIPER ARM LINKAGE BALL JOINT WHERE THE WIPER LINKAGE ATTACHES TO THE WIPER MOTOR LINKAGE.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/FRONT COIL SPRINGS (281,000 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES ORIGINALLY SOLD OR CURRENTLY REGISTERED IN THE STATES OF NEW YORK, MICHIGAN, OHIO, ILLINOIS, WISCONSIN, PENNSYLVANIA, MASSACHUSETTS, INDIANA, NEW JERSEY, MAINE, CONNECTICUT, NEW HAMPSHIRE, RHODE ISLAND, VERMONT, MINNESOTA, IOWA, MISSOURI, KENTUCKY, MARYLAND, DELAWARE, AND WEST VIRGINIA.  THE FRONT COIL SPRINGS CAN FRACTURE AS A RESULT OF CORROSION IN COMBINATION WITH SMALL CRACKS IN THE SPRINGS.

title: MOTO AMERICA INC.: MOTO AMERICA/ENGINE OIL HOSES (205 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MOTORCYCLES.  THE ENGINE OIL RADIATOR HOSES CAN SEPARATE AT THE FITTINGS, ALLOWING OIL TO LEAK.

title: Motor Coach Industries, Inc: MCI/EMERGENCY EXIT LABEL (547 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  TRANSIT COACHES EQUIPPED WITH WHEEL CHAIR LIFTS.  AN INSTRUCTION LABEL IDENTIFYING THE LOCATION OF THE EMERGENCY EXIT WAS OMITTED FROM THE WHEEL CHAIR SEATING POSITION LOCATED ON THE CURB SIDE OF THE VEHICLE.  THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 217, "BUS WINDOW RETENTION AND RELEASE."

title: Evenflo Company, Inc.: EVENFLO/TWO-IN-ONE CAR SEAT (32,000 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  TWO-IN-ONE CAR SEATS, MODELS BEGINNING WITH 636 AND 637.  THE SEAT'S BACKREST AND BASE HAVE SEPARATED WHEN THE OCCUPANT IS RESTRAINED BY THE SEAT'S 5-POINT HARNESS.  THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 213, "CHILD RESTRAINT SYSTEMS."

title: RED RIVER MANUFACTURING: RED RIVER/TRAILER PINTLE HOOK (121 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  DUMP TRAILERS WITH A BOLT-ON PINTLE HITCH MOUNTING PLATE.  CRACKS CAN DEVELOP IN THE HITCH MOUNTING PLATE LEADING TO FAILURE OF THE ASSEMBLY.

title: Webb Wheel Products, Inc.: WEBB WHEEL/BRAKE DRUM (1,057 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  STEERING AXLE BRAKE DRUMS, PART NUMBER 61958B, USED IN AN AXLE ASSEMBLY COMBINATION SUPPLIED SOLELY TO BLUE BIRD BODY COMPANY.  THE BRAKE DRUM IS OVERSIZED IN THE AREA ABOVE THE MOUNTING FLANGE AND PREVENTS THE DISC WHEEL FROM MOUNTING FLAT AGAINST THE BRAKE DRUM.

title: AMERICAN RACING EQUIPMENT: AMERICAN RACING/WHEELS (2,397 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  500/501 SERIES, 16" ALUMINUM ALLOY WHEEL (500 SERIES DESIGNED FOR FRONT-WHEEL DRIVE VEHICLES AND 501 SERIES FOR REAR-WHEEL DRIVE).  THE CENTER OF THE WHEEL CAN FRACTURE AND SEPARATE FROM THE RIM.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: BLUE BIRD/WEBB WHEEL/BRAKE DRUM (433 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  STEERING AXLE BRAKE DRUMS, PART NUMBER 61958B, USED IN AN AXLE ASSEMBLY COMBINATION SUPPLIED SOLELY TO BLUE BIRD BODY COMPANY BY WEBB WHEEL.  THE BRAKE DRUM IS OVERSIZED IN THE AREA ABOVE THE MOUNTING FLANGE AND PREVENTS THE DISC WHEEL FROM MOUNTING FLAT AGAINST THE BRAKE DRUM.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/LUG NUTS (1,520,000 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MULTI-PURPOSE VEHICLES AND LIGHT DUTY PICKUP TRUCKS.  THE LUG NUTS ON THESE VEHICLES MAY NOT CREATE SUFFICIENT CLAMP LOAD ALLOWING WHEEL MOVEMENT IN RELATION TO THE HUB/ROTOR MOUNTING SURFACE.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: VW/ENGINE COMPARTMENT WIRING (8,500 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.  THE ELECTRICAL WIRING LOCATED IN THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT WAS ROUTED TOO CLOSE TO THE ENDGE OF THE VEHICLE'S BATTERY TRAY.  THE WIRING CAN BECOME DAMAGED OVER TIME BY CHAFING AND THE AIR-CONDITIONER COMPRESSOR AND/OR THE FUEL PUMP CAN MALFUNCTION.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): CHRYSLER/GEAR SHIFT POSITION LIGHTING (457 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.  THE BACK LIGHT BULBS FOR THE LIQUID CRYSTAL DISPLAY FOR THE GEAR SHIFT POSITION (PRNDL) AND THE ODOMETER WERE NOT PROPERLY INSTALLED.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): CHRYSLER/SEAT BELT BUCKLES (4,200 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.   THE FRONT SEAT BELT BUCKLES WERE NOT PROPERLY RIVETED TO THE SUPPORT STRAP.

title: MITSUBISHI CARIBBEAN: MITSUBISHI CARIBBEAN/THROTTLE PEDAL INTERFERENCE (100 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES LOCATED IN THE CARIBBEAN.  THE DASH PANEL PAD CAN SHIFT INTERFERRING WITH THE THROTTLE CABLE CONTROL.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/FMVSS 108 (149,342 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.  THE OWNER MANUALS DO NOT CONTAIN THE REQUIREMENT INFORMATION PERTAINING TO THE VEHICLE HEADLAMP AIMING DEVICE.  THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES, AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT."

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/PARK BRAKE ROTOR AND LINING (11,200 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  SUPER DUTY SINGLE REAR WHEEL PICKUP TRUCKS.  THE PARKING BRAKE SYSTEM, WHEN ENGAGED WITH A FORCE OF 125 POUNDS APPLIED TO THE PARK BRAKE FOOT CONTROL, MAY NOT HOLD THE VEHICLES ON A 20 DEGREE GRADE.  THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 105, "HYDRAULIC BRAKE SYSTEMS."

title: IC CORPORATION: AMTRAN/FUSE/CIRCUIT BREAKER (13,422 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  SCHOOL BUSES.  THESE VEHICLES WERE BUILT WITH INADEQUATE CIRCUIT PROTECTION DEVICES (FUSES OR CIRCUIT BREAKERS) ALLOWING THE HEADLAMPS, DURING HIGH BEAM OPERATION, TO IMPOSE TOO MUCH LOAD CAUSING THE PROTECTION DEVICE TO OPEN THE CIRCUIT.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/FMVSS 108 (9,600 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.  THE OWNER MANUALS DO NOT CONTAIN THE REQUIREMENT INFORMATION PERTAINING TO THE VEHICLE HEADLAMP AIMING DEVICE.  THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES, AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT."

title: Motor Coach Industries, Inc: MCI/TIE ROD BALL JOINT COTTER PIN/NUT (296 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  TRANSIT COACHES.  THE TIE ROD BALL JOINT COTTER PIN AND NUT MAY BE MISSING OR THE NUT MAY BE LOOSE.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: BLUE BIRD/FMVSS 217/REAR DOOR (385 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  SCHOOL BUSES.  THESE BUSES WERE NOT EQUIPPED WITH A POSITIVE HOLD OPEN DEVICE (RETAINER) FOR THE REAR EMERGENCY DOOR.  THIS DOES NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 217, "BUS WINDOW RETENTION AND RELEASE."

title: Volvo Trucks North America: VOLVO TRUCK/ACCURIDE/ALUMINUM DUAL WHEELS (3,065 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH AFTERMARKET ALUMINUM DUAL WHEELS, 22.5X8.25, ONE-PIECE, TUBELESS, SUPPLIED BY ACCURIDE/AKW.  CERTAIN DESIGN REVISIONS COMBINED WITH PROCESS CONDITIONS CAUSED FATIGUE CRACKS IN THESE WHEELS.

title: SUNLINE COACH COMPANY: SUNLINE COACH/DEXTER AXLE/WHEEL BEARINGS (276 affected)
summary: VEHICLE  DESCRIPTION:  TRAVEL AND FOLDING TRAILERS EQUIPPED WITH DEXTER AXLES.   THE WHEEL BEARINGS USED IN SOME OF THESE AXLES HAVE A METALLURGICAL DEFECT CAUSING EARLY FAILURE.

title: Shyft Group: SPARTAN/ABS (7 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  FIRE TRUCK CHASSIS EQUIPPED WITH TELMA RETARDER AND WABCO VERSION 'D' ANTI-LOCK BRAKE SYSTEM (ABS).  THE ABS TEST MODE WIRING WAS INCORRECTLY WIRED THROUGH THE CONSOLE RESULTING IN THE INABILITY TO READ AND CLEAR THE BLINK CODES ON THESE FIRE TRUCKS.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: BLUE BIRD/FUEL HOSES (64 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  REAR ENGINE SCHOOL BUSES EQUIPPED WITH OPTION 04888 DEDICATED COMPRESSED NATURAL GAS (CNG) FUEL PACKAGE.  THE 24" LONG STAINLESS STEEL BRAIDED FUEL HOSES CAN LEAK AT THE HOSE END FITTINGS.

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: PORSCHE/TRANSMISSION (738 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH TIPTRONIC TRANSMISSIONS.  THE BEARING SLEEVES CAN SEIZE IN THE INTERMEDIATE SELECTOR LEVERS.

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: PORSCHE/IGNITION SWITCH (3,217 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.   THE IGNITION SWITCH CAN CRACK AND CAUSE ELECTRICAL FAILURES.

title: Isuzu Motors Limited: ISUZU/REAR SHOULDER BELT (3,044 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES.  THE STRENGTH OF THE REAR SEAT BELT SHOULDER ANCHORAGE IS NOT TO DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS AND DOES NOT FULLY COMPLY WITH REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 210, "SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY ANCHORAGES."

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/AIR BAG DEPLOYMENT (102,627 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.  INADVERTENT DEPLOYMENT OF THE AIR BAGS CAN OCCUR DUE TO WATER INTRUSION.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: FREIGHTLINER/FMVSS 121 (45 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  HEADY DUTY TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH 36" REAR BRAKE CHAMBERS.  THE BRAKE SYSTEM DOES NOT MEET THE AIR RESERVOIR VOLUME REQUIREMENT OF FMVSS 121, "AIR BRAKE SYSTEMS."

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: NAVISTAR/ELECTRICAL RELAY CORROSION (16,012 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH PROSLEEPER BUNKS.  A MICRO RELAY LOCATED BEHIND THE HVAC CONTROL PANEL IN THE BUNK CAN CORRODE FROM MOISTURE.

title: Collins Bus Corporation: COLLINS BUS/FMVSS 301 (432 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  DUAL REAR WHEEL SCHOOL BUSES BUILT ON FORD E-350 AND E-450 'SUPER DUTY' CUTAWAY CHASSIS, EXTERIOR BODY WIDTH OF 80", GROSS VEHICLE WEIGHT RATING OF 11,500 OR 14,050 POUNDS.  THESE BUSES MAY HAVE A MODIFICATION TO THE FRAME RAIL CONSISTING OF A NOTCH IN THE LOWER FLANGE OF THE LEFT-HAND FRAME RAIL FORWARD OF THE FRAME CROSS MEMBER.  THIS MODIFICATION CAN AFFECT COMPLIANCE TO FMVSS NO. 301, "FUEL SYSTEM INTEGRITY."

title: Strick Trailers, LLC: STRICK/ROCKWELL-WABCO/ABS CONTROL UNITS (334 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  TRAILERS EQUIPPED WITH ANTILOCK BRAKING SYSTEM (ABS) ELECTRONIC CONTROL UNITS (ECU)  FOR OVER-THE-ROAD TRAILER APPLICATIONS.  THE COVER SEAL (O-RING) MAY HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY INSTALLED IN CERTAIN EASY-STOP TRAILER ABS ELECTRONIC CONTROL UNITS.  AN INCORRECTLY INSTALLED SEAL COULD PERMIT WATER TO ENTER THE ECU CAUSING A FAULT TO DEVELOP.  THIS WILL CAUSE THE VEHICLE'S TRAILER ABS WARNING LAMP TO ILLUMINATE IMMEDIATELY WHEN THE WATER CONTACTS THE BOARD, DEACTIVATING ALL OR PART OF THE ABS.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: NAVISTAR/FURON/AUTO TRANSMISSION (1,309 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:   TRUCKS, SCHOOL BUSES AND TRANSIT BUSES EQUIPPED WITH AN OPTIONAL AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION SHIFT LEVER THAT INCLUDES A PARK BRAKE POSITION.    THE TRANSMISSION SHIFTER/PARK BRAKE LEVER CAN BIND BEFORE FULLY ENGAGING IN THE PARK BRAKE POSITION CAUSING A FALSE PARK CONDITION.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/LOWER STEERING COLUMN (90,000 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MEDIUM DUTY TRUCKS AND CHASSIS-CABS.  ONE OR MORE OF THE FOUR RIVETS ON THE LOWER STEERING SHAFT FLEX COUPLING MAY NOT HAVE BEEN CRIMPED DURING THE SUB-ASSEMBLY PROCESS.
